product.title: 45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona

description.text: Lift off from Tusayan on a 45-minute helicopter flight tracing the eastern Grand Canyon and Colorado River corridor. Narrated aerial routing covers Kaibab National Forest, Desert View Watchtower, Marble Canyon, and the Painted Desert beyond the park boundary.

highlights: Aerial views of the eastern Grand Canyon and Colorado River
Flyover of Desert View Watchtower and Marble Canyon
Climate-controlled cabin with oversized viewing windows
Multiple daily departures from Grand Canyon Airport area

start.description: Check in at the helicopter terminal near Grand Canyon National Park Airport, Tusayan, AZ 86023. Arrive 30 minutes before your scheduled flight.

end.description: Land back at the Tusayan helicopter terminal after the 45-minute aerial loop.

product.itinerarySummary: Lift off from Tusayan on a 45-minute helicopter flight tracing the eastern Grand Canyon and Colorado River corridor.

itineraryItems.title: Kaibab National Forest
itineraryItems.description: Depart over ponderosa pine forest on the canyon's south plateau.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon National Park
itineraryItems.description: Sweep along the main canyon chasm with views of layered rim and inner gorge.

itineraryItems.title: Painted Desert
itineraryItems.description: Fly toward the Painted Desert badlands northeast of the canyon.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon Desert View Watchtower
itineraryItems.description: Circle the Desert View Watchtower at the eastern South Rim.

itineraryItems.title: Marble Canyon
itineraryItems.description: Follow Marble Canyon upstream where the Colorado River narrows.

itineraryItems.title: Colorado River
itineraryItems.description: Track the Colorado River bend through the deepest sections of the flight path.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
